name: Gasthof zum weißen Lamm
kurzbeschreibung:
**The Inn at the White Lamb in Tirol**

Welcome to **Gasthof zum weißen Lamm**, a charming guesthouse nestled in the heart of **Tirol**. Here, you’ll find warmth, tradition, and the finest local flavors in a cozy alpine setting.

Our rustic yet inviting rooms offer breathtaking views of the surrounding mountains, while our hearty **Tiroler** cuisine—think tender **Kaiserschmarrn**, savory **Gröstl**, and crisp **Speckknödel**—will leave you craving more. After a day of hiking, skiing, or exploring **Innsbruck** or the **Zillertal**, unwind with a glass of **Tiroler** wine or a frothy **Schnaps** by the crackling fireplace.

Whether you’re seeking relaxation or adventure, **Gasthof zum weißen Lamm** promises an authentic taste of **Tirol**’s hospitality. Come experience the magic—*Willkommen in Tirol!*
